dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent over Ferfer Woreda, Shabelle District, Shabelle Region, Ethiopia as of 30 March 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230327SOM** This map illustrates satellite detected surface waters in Ferfer Woreda, Shabelle District, Shabelle Region, Ethiopia as observed from a SPOT-6 image acquired on 30 March 2023 at 07:01 UTC. Within the analyzed area of about 260km2, about 4 km2 of lands appear to be flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
